anomalies.observed: In the netlist, the TPS1H200 high-side switch output pin 7 is connected to J10 pin 2 (Net-(J10-Pin_2)), while J6 pin 2 is connected to the MCU GPIO1 / heater-control net (/Microcontroller/NET0007) together with U9 IN/DIAG_EN and the status LED D3.
anomalies.expected: The specification states that the heater switch OUT pin should feed the intended heater connector J6 pin 2, not the MCU control net.

evidence.quote: OUT (pin 7) feeds the heater connector J6 pin 2

anomalies.impact: If a heater is connected to the connector designated J6 in the intended design, it will see the 3.3 V GPIO1 control signal instead of the switched 12 V output from the high-side switch. The heater would not operate as intended and the ESP32 GPIO could be overstressed. The actual switched 12 V output is instead present on J10.

parsed.summary: The netlist otherwise matches the specified power, SPI, thermocouple, fan, and heater-switch topology, but the heater connector assignment appears anomalous: the high-side switch output is routed to J10 while J6 is tied to the MCU heater-control net, contrary to the specification.
